protocol.selection: Outcome-independent fixed day/symbol hash cohort; TOP-only diagnostic symbols excluded; independently selected fixed-cohort/TOP overlaps retained
protocol.baseline: One direction per symbol/cutoff from the sign of the preceding3hour BUY-snapshot price return; zero abstains; no volume feature or future outcome chooses direction

comparisons.spot: Both previous and recent3hour spot aggressor imbalance aligned with the pre-cutoff price direction versus all other observed patterns
comparisons.funding: Last actual settled funding implies direction pays versus receives/zero; no assumption of standard funding interval

protocol.comparison_denominator: Each grouping compared with exactly the same component-available price-baseline slots; all missing features and missing outcomes separately retained
protocol.outcomes: Next6hour directional close-to-close return >0 continuation, <=0 noncontinuation; >=5percent secondary research label, not a trading threshold or PnL
protocol.minimums_meaning: Operational descriptive-review threshold only, not power/significance, proof of predictive edge, or authorization to promote
protocol.readiness_uses: Reserved days and day-symbol clusters with observed outcomes and all3component flags; missing reserved days explicit

operational_bounds.deduplication: Latest public research revision per day across accounts, ordered by created_at then report_id, not outcome or coverage
operational_bounds.operational_failure_notifications: Excluded by exact DAILY_MOVER_JOB_FAILURE kind; ordinary missing research is retained UNKNOWN
operational_bounds.failures: Evaluation exceptions or invalid output produce a sanitized UNKNOWN subsection and do not block the original report/notification or trading
operational_bounds.idempotency: Mature unchanged inputs produce identical digest despite advancing clock; changed evaluation appends immutable report revision without repeating dailyDM

candidate_release_related_regression.scope: Public research, pure features/evaluation, storage, readonly history, daily job, actual-path research, notification and failure boundaries. Not whole-repository trading E2E or profitability acceptance.

read_only_real_data_canary.caveat: One day, dependent symbol/cutoff observations, no large-move outcomes in fixed cohort, historical receipt unproven. Descriptive only, not strategy win-rate or evidence to change entry rules.

rollback: Between independent oneshot runs restore only the research pointer to previous_release. No DB migration or trading restart required; retain immutable research revisions.
remaining_work: Collect the fixed reserved dates and failures without retuning rules against their results; elapsed days alone never prove predictive value.
Current fixed cohort has no >=5percent6hour directional outcomes, so improvement at capturing large moves is untested.
Live pre-cutoff receipt, historical catalog coverage, execution costs and prospective shadow decisions remain prerequisites for any entry/holding policy impact.
No continuous depth or liquidation evidence was added; participant inventory, absorption and intent remain unidentifiable here.
Indicator-v4 activation remains a separate blocked candidate; this release does not activate it.
method_reference_note: Temporal ordering and gap concerns inform the design; this fixed-rule implementation does not use sklearn or claim a calibrated forecasting model.
